mechanics.whenRead: One of the two January mandatory objectives. It follows 01-03 ('Our objectives follow').
rules: Mandatory objective: build 3 new supply centers.
Vertical progress track of four circles, numbered 0, 1, 2, 3 from bottom to top.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the objective-card back (haven star) with no rules text. Unlike 01-05, this face does not print 'Add this card to your pool of objectives.' It is still one of the two objectives 01-03 says follow.
